links.outcome: Answer accuracy and ROUGE-L with vs without retrieval grounding on nursing questions
links.quote: For ChatGLM2-6B, ROUGE-L increased from (30.73 ± 1.48) % to (64.27 ± 0.27) %, and accuracy increased from (49.08 ± 0.92) % to (75.83 ± 0.35) %.

unlisted_practices: Nursing question filtering with a supervised classifier before retrieval
Deploying LLM on hospital intranet servers via Docker containers

screen.practice: retrieval grounding added to base LLMs
screen.reason: The study evaluates the deployment of a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework on hospital intranet servers to ground LLM outputs in verified nursing knowledge, comparing accuracy and hallucination reduction with and without RAG on existing models (ChatGLM2-6B and LLaMA2-7B).
